messages:
satz: quick sync thread 1: finalizing nav IA changes for console. main goals: stable deep links, shallow breadcrumbs, accessible compact sidebar, and shareable OG previews. want to lock assumptions before the review
emily: big asks from PM: links shared in chat must render previews and land on the right tab/panel. history routing + server rewrite for known entity routes is the easiest path
harper: agreed. canonical path proposal: /orgs/:orgId/projects/:projectId/models/:modelId (and similar for /deploys/:deployId). also allow short aliases /m/:legacyId and /d/:legacyId that server-redirect to canonical
rachel: breadcrumb rule: keep it shallow — Org > Project > Models > {Model name}. show human-friendly names, fallback to slugified id when missing. avoid echoing collection slugs in breadcrumbs
emily: panel selection should be query-param driven: ?tab=metrics rather than hashes. we can still smooth-scroll to anchors client-side on hydration if a more granular fragment is needed
satz: sidebar behavior: split Workloads into explicit Models + Deploys under an "AI" group. support compact (icon-only) mode but preserve semantic DOM order for keyboard nav. pinned shortcuts row above groups would be great for heavy users
a11y-bot: accessibility checklist (quick): add a visible "Skip to main content" link as first focusable element; left nav must have role=navigation; group toggles need aria-expanded and aria-controls; active nav item must carry aria-current="page"; pinned region should be role=list with accessible names for items
harper: focus management: after navigation, set tabindex=-1 on page H1 and call focus() so keyboard users land on content rather than the nav. ensure focus order is consistent regardless of collapsed state
emily: OG/meta: ops needs a list of canonical route patterns to whitelist for the SSR/meta shim. minimal payload: og:title, og:description, og:image optional. ops, can you serve from a cache to avoid DB on every preview request?
av-bot: ops note: yes - we can implement a small metadata cache served via rewrite layer. need TTL and a bootstrap list from deploys. will add redirects for /m/:id and /d/:id. recommend a mapping service for legacy resolution
satz: microcopy: plural nouns for list pages ("Models"), singular for detail pages ("Model"), Title Case for breadcrumbs. add guidance about truncation rules for long names in breadcrumb (show start + ellipsis + end)
emily: dev snippet for route table to sync up:
```
routes: [
  '/orgs/:orgId/projects/:projectId/models',
  '/orgs/:orgId/projects/:projectId/models/:modelId',
  '/orgs/:orgId/projects/:projectId/deploys/:deployId',
  '/shortcuts/:userId'
]
redirects: [
  {from: '/m/:legacyId', to: '/orgs/:orgId/projects/:projectId/models/:modelId'},
  {from: '/d/:legacyId', to: '/orgs/:orgId/projects/:projectId/deploys/:deployId'}
]
```
we'll auto-resolve org/project when possible for legacy aliases
harper: UX nit: when opening from a pinned shortcut show canonical breadcrumb and a non-intrusive toast "Opened from your shortcuts". announce via aria-live polite for assistive tech
a11y-bot: also flag animated toasts for reduced-motion preference and ensure toast dismiss button is accessible via keyboard and announced to SRs
rachel: telemetry: emit deep_link_open with properties {origin: nav|pin|share, routePattern, projectId} so product can measure shareability and pin utility
satz: testing plan: e2e keyboard-only nav, pinned create/open, deep-link landing with proper OG meta, redirect coverage for aliases, accessibility smoke tests for skip link / aria-current / focus behavior
emily: action items: 1) harper to update Figma with compact nav + pinned row (prototype) 2) emily to draft redirect map + route table PR 3) ops/nav-bot to add rewrite rules + metadata cache 4) a11y-bot to produce checklist + e2e keyboard test cases 5) rachel to add telemetry spec
harper: I'll post the prototype link and sketches in the channel by EOD, will include keyboard-flow recordings
satz: thanks everyone 1. we'll review this in design critique tomorrow at 11:00. please add any missed edge cases before then :thumbsup:
